source_snapshot.test_set: DPoC for BMC KVM function check
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify SUT recipe, clear logs, launch KVM through BMC Web UI, connect the system with a USB hub and VGA monitor, verify normal console function, collect results/photos and review new logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies the physical and visual manual boundary but does not define the USB-hub/VGA topology, the observable meaning of normal KVM function, log preservation or per-path evidence.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the BMC Web KVM console displays and accepts owner-approved interaction normally while the exact prescribed USB hub and physical VGA-monitor configuration is attached to the SUT.
original_test_intent.target: The verified SUT and BMC/KVM session, the platform-specified USB controller/port and hub/peripheral chain, and the physical VGA output/monitor path identified by the owner topology.
original_test_intent.scope: One controlled BMC Web KVM session with the required physical USB-hub and VGA-monitor condition, source-estimated at 5 attended and 5 machine minutes, including pre/post log evidence. Session reachability, USB enumeration alone or a local VGA image alone is insufficient.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve a traceable baseline, establish the exact physical topology under operator control, launch the correct BMC Web KVM, prove remote video corresponds to the intended SUT and remains responsive, perform only the approved harmless input checks, correlate local VGA and USB observations, close the session and verify health/restoration.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source estimates 5 attended and 5 machine minutes and defines one session; it does not specify dwell time, USB peripheral count, input sequence, resolutions or repetitions. Use the owner checklist rather than inventing these values.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The required USB hub/peripherals and VGA monitor operate in their specified topology, the correct BMC KVM video remains current and usable, approved input reaches only the intended SUT, no unexpected disconnect/reset/enumeration or error occurs, and the platform returns to the approved final state.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware/browser/KVM identity; signed physical topology; hub, peripheral, monitor and cable identity; baseline and log-handling audit; connection photos; local VGA reference and remote KVM captures; harmless input action/response; USB/BMC/host event evidence; timestamps; session close, restoration and final health.
ambiguities: The source grammar does not identify which SUT USB port the hub uses, what devices attach to the hub, whether the hub is powered, or whether the VGA monitor is a separate local reference path.
`KVM should work normally` does not define required video resolution/refresh, latency, persistence, keyboard/mouse actions or dwell time.
The source requests log clearing without defining export, authorization or an acceptable timestamp-delta alternative.
The safe UI/OS context for remote input is not defined.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly maps the physical Web-UI/USB/VGA/visual workflow to MANUAL ONLY, rejects reachability or enumeration as complete proof and limits dangerous controls. It assumes a generic hub/monitor relationship without making the source's topology ambiguity a gate, omits the 5/5-minute estimates and does not explicitly reconcile the requested log clear.

applicable_history.decision: V2 establishes the correct manual boundary and safety controls. No later user ruling supplies the hub/peripheral/VGA topology or a quantitative definition of normal KVM behavior.
Physical operations and visual evidence remain manual; state-changing preparation such as clearing logs requires evidence preservation and explicit authorization.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep MANUAL ONLY, but gate execution on an explicit USB-hub/peripheral/VGA topology and observable KVM checklist. Preserve the 5-minute estimates and handle source-requested log clearing through pre-export plus approval or an approved timestamp baseline.

available_now: The source requires a BMC Web KVM session under a USB-hub plus VGA-monitor condition and requires photo/result plus post-test log evidence.
Read-only identity, firmware, browser/KVM compatibility, current USB inventory, BMC/host health and existing logs can be collected before physical changes.
missing_inputs: The BMC/platform owner must supply the exact hub/peripheral/VGA port topology and a checklist for normal remote video and input behavior.
The lab owner must supply approved hub, peripherals, VGA monitor/cable, known-good proof, physical connection sequence, input-safe screen, log-baseline policy and qualified operator.
The system owner must approve physical hot-plug, KVM login/interaction, any log clear, maintenance window and recovery.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/platform owner defines topology and KVM criteria; the lab operator supplies/handles physical fixtures; the system owner controls credentials, interaction authorization, log policy and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record SUT/BMC/firmware and browser/KVM-client identity, current session/health state, USB topology and complete dmesg/syslog/SEL without clearing them.
Verify fixture model/compatibility and draft the evidence matrix without connecting hardware or opening a control-capable KVM session.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not guess hub placement/peripherals or treat VGA as routed through the hub; connect unknown hardware; clear logs without export and approval; use wrong BMC; expose credentials; issue reset/power/virtual-media/BIOS-changing commands; type into an unsafe context; or claim PASS from session opening, USB enumeration or one static image.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Approve and photograph the exact topology and harmless interaction checklist, preserve the log baseline, establish known-good fixtures and recovery, obtain authorization, then reconcile remote video/input, local VGA, USB, logs and final health for the one session.

revision_candidate.test_name: BMC Web KVM Function with Approved USB Hub and VGA Monitor
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify normal BMC Web KVM video and approved input behavior on the correct SUT while the prescribed physical USB-hub and VGA-monitor topology is present.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact SUT, BMC and firmware with supported browser/KVM client, host OS/graphics state, owner-defined USB port/hub/peripheral chain and physical VGA output/monitor configuration.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One authorized KVM session for the verified SUT, covering remote video and harmless input plus the exact local USB-hub and VGA condition. Use the source's 5-minute attended/machine estimates only as planning data.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/BMC identity and credentials; firmware/browser/KVM compatibility; physical topology diagram; USB hub model/power mode/port and attached devices; VGA output, monitor, cable and display expectations; known-good fixtures; video/input checklist and dwell rule; safe interaction context; log policy; approval and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export and hash existing dmesg/syslog/SEL before an approved clear, or record an owner-approved timestamp baseline. The operator establishes and photographs the exact USB/VGA topology. Launch the intended BMC Web KVM, confirm the correct SUT and live remote video against the local reference, perform only approved harmless keyboard/mouse actions, observe continuity and events, close the session, restore the required final topology and inspect log deltas.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BMC/firmware and physical ports verified; compatible known-good hub/peripherals/monitor/cables ready; topology and normal-function checklist approved; safe screen selected; authenticated BMC access; logs preserved; no conflicting KVM user or critical operation; qualified operator, maintenance window and recovery available.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version and topology diagram; fixture identities/known-good proof; baseline export or timestamp and any clear audit; connection photos; BMC session identity/time; remote KVM screenshots/video and local VGA reference; exact harmless input and observed response; USB/session/BMC/host logs; disconnect/error observations; close/restoration and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved BMC KVM and USB/VGA topology checklist for the exact platform, constrained by source criteria `KVM should work normally`. Session reachability or enumeration alone is not acceptance evidence.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Qualified operator and authorized KVM user only. Do not invent topology or criteria, connect incompatible hardware, clear unexported logs, share secrets, interact with the wrong SUT, issue power/reset/virtual-media/firmware actions, enter destructive input or continue after unexpected USB/KVM/platform behavior.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Approval is required for physical connection/hot-plug, BMC login and remote input, any log clearing, maintenance timing and recovery. The owner must approve the topology and harmless-action checklist.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator establishes and observes physical USB/VGA state and directly verifies visual/input behavior. An agent may prepare the checklist and organize BMC/host logs and supplied captures, but remote reachability cannot replace trusted physical and visual observations.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong target, blank/frozen/wrong video, input misdirection, unexpected enumeration/disconnect, BMC/SUT fault or connector issue, stop interaction, preserve captures/logs, close the session, remove or restore fixtures under the approved sequence and use the authorized BMC/physical recovery path without improvised reset/power actions.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong or ambiguous SUT/BMC/topology; unsupported fixture or unsafe connector; unpreserved log clear; credential/session conflict; remote/local display mismatch; blank/frozen/stale video; input failure or wrong-target action; USB disconnect/overcurrent/unexpected device; BMC/host reset or health error; missing evidence; or failed restoration.

identified_defects: DeepSeek does not define topology, normal-function observations or complete evidence.
The source leaves the USB-hub/peripheral/VGA relationship and KVM functional checklist ambiguous.
V2 does not explicitly prevent an agent from assuming the VGA path is part of the USB hub or selecting arbitrary hub peripherals.
V2 does not preserve the source's 5/5-minute planning values or fully reconcile the requested log clear.
reason_for_change: Ensure the manual test uses the intended physical topology and proves both remote-console behavior and the prescribed local condition without inventing device routing, losing logs or allowing unsafe KVM input.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-BMC-00486-V002
new_technical_evidence.applicability: This exact BMC KVM and physical-fixture case
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source explicitly requires BMC Web KVM, a USB hub, VGA monitor, result/photo collection and post-test log review within 5/5-minute estimates.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The physical topology and observable normal-function criteria are not provided.

removed_ambiguities: Treats the USB hub and VGA monitor as owner-mapped topology elements rather than inferring an unsupported signal path.
Separates correct remote video, approved input, local VGA condition and USB state as distinct evidence dimensions.
Defines safe log-baseline and input handling and preserves the 5-minute estimates as planning data.
resolved_blockers: Physical and visual work makes the case MANUAL ONLY but feasible with a qualified operator; it is not semantically BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits an exact topology, fixtures, functional checklist, safe interaction context, log policy, credentials, operator, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains V2's manual boundary while closing a test-defining topology ambiguity, preserving source timing/log intent and preventing session reachability, arbitrary USB attachment or one static image from becoming a false completion.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered one authorized session on the exact SUT/BMC, the owner-prescribed hub/peripheral and separate local VGA topology, remote video, harmless input, five-minute planning-only meaning, log preservation, restoration and final health. It rejected reachability/enumeration-only completion and unapproved power/reset/media/firmware actions. Missing topology, fixtures, checklist and dwell rule are PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT; guessing them would be MODEL_PLANNING_ERROR.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 2206 launches BMC Web KVM while a USB hub and VGA monitor are connected, requires normal console function, photos/results and post-test log review, and estimates 5/5 minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly requires manual visual/input proof but does not make the ambiguous hub/peripheral/VGA routing an owner-supplied gate or fully preserve log/timing details.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Permit identity/log/fixture preparation; require exact topology, known-good hardware, safe input checklist, preserved logs, operator and approval before any physical or control-capable action.
